advisory.finding: The opt-out marker acceptance path in test_every_alarm_declares_alarm_actions / test_every_alarm_declares_ok_actions is never exercised end-to-end: no test constructs an actionless alarm block bearing a valid `# rebar:allow-actionless-alarm: <reason>` marker and asserts the guard PASSES it.
